resources.string: Check the permissions needed for casting. Android will ask you what to share each time you start screen sharing.
Required for casting. Confirm it in the system chooser when you start sharing.
Android requires audio permission to share playback audio. The microphone is not captured.
Show casting status. You can keep casting if this is denied.
Allow your paired receiver to tap and swipe during full-screen sharing.
Enter a 4-character cloud code, or choose a nearby device for local casting.
Enter the 4-character local code shown on this receiver.
Clear device and use a cloud code
Connect to the same Wi-Fi, then select your receiver.
Enter the code already on screen
Your screen is visible on the receiver.
Tap Start to choose what to share.
No available update was found. You can check again later.
Find a nearby receiver to cast over your local network.
Shared app is not visible; waiting to resume
Screen sharing stopped after the phone was locked. Tap to reselect.
Screen sharing stopped. Tap to reselect content.
Screen sharing permission was not granted. Tap to retry.
Screen sharing needs attention. Tap to retry.
Shared app is not visible\nReturn to the app to resume automatically
Phone locked. Screen sharing stopped\nUnlock the phone and reselect content in NearHub Cast
Shared app closed or screen sharing stopped\nReselect content in NearHub Cast
Screen sharing permission was not granted\nRetry in NearHub Cast
Screen sharing is temporarily unavailable\nReselect content in NearHub Cast
Shared app is not visible; return to it to resume automatically
Phone was locked. Unlock it and reselect shared content.
Shared app closed or screen sharing stopped. Reselect content.
Screen sharing permission was not granted. Try again.
Screen sharing is temporarily unavailable. Reselect content.

Allow your paired receiver to perform touch gestures while sharing the entire screen. This service performs gestures and does not read accessibility screen content. Stop sharing or turn off remote control in NearHub Cast to end access.
While sharing the entire screen, your paired receiver can tap and swipe on this device. Turn this off at any time.
Remote control is off. Screen sharing remains available.
Remote control requires Android 8.0 or later.
Accessibility permission is needed for remote control.
Permission is enabled; waiting for the system service. Check accessibility settings if this continues.
Releasing previous input. Remote control is paused.
Verifying the shared screen… Brief corner markers are normal.
This share could not be verified for remote control. You can keep sharing, or select the entire screen and retry.
The paired receiver is controlling this screen.
Remote control is temporarily unavailable. Screen sharing continues. Retry, or reconnect the receiver.
System input is unavailable. Unlock the phone and check touch exploration or magnification settings.
Ready. Enable remote control on the receiver to begin.
Accessibility is ready. Connect a receiver and share the entire screen to use remote control.
Waiting for the receiver’s remote control connection…

Your paired receiver can perform taps, swipes, drags and multi-touch gestures while you share the entire screen.

In Accessibility settings, find “NearHub Cast remote control” under installed/downloaded apps and enable the service. The service performs gestures without reading accessibility screen content. You can turn off remote control or stop sharing at any time.

You can also continue with screen sharing only.
Remote control is not enabled yet
The system has not connected the NearHub Cast accessibility service. You can check settings again or continue with screen sharing only.

Open Accessibility → Installed or Downloaded apps → NearHub Cast remote control.

If Android shows “Restricted setting”, open NearHub Cast’s App info and use “Allow restricted settings” in the top-right menu if it is available. Then return to Accessibility and enable the service.

System or device-management restrictions may prevent enabling it. Screen sharing remains available.
This device cannot open the requested settings page directly. Open the system Settings app, then find Accessibility → NearHub Cast remote control, or Apps → NearHub Cast → Permissions.
Android requires audio recording permission to share system playback audio. NearHub Cast’s casting pipeline does not capture the microphone. The system screen-sharing chooser will follow.
The current casting mode needs audio permission for system playback. You can retry or close this dialog and remain connected.
Allow the audio permission for NearHub Cast in App info → Permissions, then return. Screen sharing will continue only if the original connection is still active.
Audio permission was not granted. You can retry from Start Screen Cast.
Accessibility is not connected yet. Screen sharing is still available.
Choose a receiver on the same network, then enter the pairing code shown on its screen.
No receivers found yet. Check that the receiver is online and on the same network.
Select to display the pairing code
This device does not support NearHub Cast casting
Local network access is blocked. Check system permissions or enter a pairing code manually.
Discovery is unavailable. Check the network and scan again.
Compare every group below with the full fingerprint on the receiver screen. Trust only an exact match. This comparison expires after one minute.
I compared the full fingerprint in person and every group matches
The receiver displayed its pairing code. Read it on the receiver, then enter it manually to connect.
The receiver cannot display this right now. Try again later or enter the code already shown on the receiver.
Too many requests. Please try again later.
This receiver cannot display a pairing code automatically. Use the code on its screen, or a cloud pairing code.
The receiver went offline or its network information changed. Return to the list and select it again.
The receiver identity has changed. The connection was blocked. Check the selected device, then remove its saved connection before pairing again.
The receiver connection has expired. Select the device again.
No connection is saved for this receiver. Retry to pair it again.
This fingerprint differs from the saved key. Confirm that this is the same receiver before replacing trust.
Read the pairing code on the receiver screen and enter it here.
Device trust could not be read or saved. The request was stopped. You can still enter a pairing code manually.
The receiver returned an invalid response. Try again or enter a pairing code manually.
Could not reach the receiver. Check the device and local network, then try again.
Enter the selected receiver’s local pair code. This connection uses the local network.
Enter the receiver’s cloud pair code, or discover a receiver for local casting.
The receiver’s local casting service is unavailable. Enable it on the receiver and retry.
The saved receiver connection is no longer valid. Select the device again.
Requested the receiver’s local pair code. Use that local code to connect.
This receiver cannot select a code type. Confirm its screen shows the local code; cloud codes cannot join locally.
Enter a four-character letter or number pair code.
The code is invalid or expired. Check the new code for the selected connection type and retry.
Connection timed out. Check the receiver and network, then retry.
Sender and receiver use different remote control protocols. Update to matching versions and reconnect. Casting can continue.
The receiver sent an invalid control target. Update the receiver and reconnect. Casting can continue.
The receiver’s remote control master switch is off. Enable it on the receiver.
The receiver has not allowed control for this cast. Allow it on the receiver.
The receiver allows control but has not requested it.
The receiver has not accepted this Android full-screen input source. Check its version and source state.
The input channel is ready. Activate the receiver’s casting window to interact.
The receiver is waiting for this device to confirm control.
The receiver could not open the input stream. Check its input mode or error message.
The receiver could not start this input mode. Retry remote control or choose Native under Input mode.
